gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sono: Stentiga spreads its letters wide, with crossbars as heavy as the stems and openings like a door left ajar. Sono feels friendly beside it, with generous spacing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stentiga stretches out, refined and luxurious. Stack Sans Notch sits beside it with rod-stock strokes and open curves, a clean, big-bodied counterweight to all that spaced-out polish.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-text: Stentiga lays out its wide-spaced, luxurious letters with crossbars matching the stems. Stack Sans Text carries a marker-like constant line and curve endings kept well apart, which would keep paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-tiktok-sans: Stentiga has no calligraphic swell on any downstroke, just refined, spread-out letters with wide-set openings. TikTok Sans follows with an x-height nearly touching its capitals, which makes paragraphs feel modern and brisk.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-abeezee: Gaping mouths on the e and strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle give Visitor its nostalgic, digital stamp. ABeeZee answers as friendly plain sans, its neon-tube thickness and terminals clear of the stem keeping the page approachable.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads modern and businesslike, its x-height close to the cap height and its round letters cupped rather than clenched. Visitor adds a nostalgic, digital edge above, so paragraphs feel like tracing one thick thread.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-alexandria: Alexandria is a clean plain sans with wide open c terminals and a lofty body between short stems above and below. Visitor, by contrast, draws every stroke like rod stock, nostalgic and digital, with gaping e mouths.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-amiko: Visitor draws stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders over big bowls. Amiko sits quietly beside it, its crayon-mark lowercase and outward-pointing terminals feeling modern.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari keeps its letter mouths distinctly open and its middle zone lofty, giving a modern, neutral sans body. Visitor's fineliner-flat line makes the strongest single quality here a crisp nostalgic-versus-modern split.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands in a plain sans with x-height reaching high like a squared-off woodblock letter, terminals stopping far from the stem. Visitor, a thread of ink with no swelling, handles the nostalgic, digital display work while the body carries the text.
